codes.description: The authored expression has more than one valid implicit-multiplication parse.
The calculation or request was cancelled.
A persisted dependency graph violates the acyclic execution invariant.
A referenced assignment failed and has no published value.
The operation combines quantities with incompatible dimensions.
The expression divides by zero.
A mathematical function received an operand outside its real domain.
Assignment IDs must be unique throughout the document.
Local symbol IDs must be unique throughout the document.
Page IDs must be unique throughout the document.
Unit prefix IDs must be unique.
Statement IDs must be unique throughout the document.
An expression binds an engine token or symbol more than once.
Symbol IDs must be unique and must not collide across symbol classes.
Document-level display names are not unique after normalization.
Unit IDs must be unique in a unit registry.
Unit symbols must be unique in a unit registry.
An RPC frame exceeds the configured maximum size.
The calculation engine failed unexpectedly.
The calculation order does not contain every top-level statement exactly once.
A persisted dependency graph has an invalid structure.
The calculation document or its integrity metadata is invalid.
The supplied document digest does not match the canonical document bytes.
A mathematical function was supplied with an unsupported number of arguments.
An RPC message does not conform to the supported JSON-RPC envelope.
A source-map, authored-number, or unit path does not resolve in the MathJSON tree.
A symbol normalizedName does not match the canonical normalization rule.
A unit prefix scale is not a reduced positive rational.
A unit dimension vector is not canonical.
The built-in unit registry is structurally or semantically invalid.
A unit scale is not a reduced positive rational.
A local variable is referenced outside its lexical scope.
A local variable is referenced before its declaration.
A numeric operation exceeds the supported range or precision.
A numeric operation underflows the configured precision.
A deterministic evaluation resource limit was exceeded.
A document, expression, RPC payload, or result fails schema validation.
A local declaration shadows a document symbol or visible local.
A MathJSON engine token has no stable symbol binding.
A unit expression cannot be parsed or resolved.
Unit metadata refers to a different registry version.
An assignment target is neither a document symbol nor a visible local.
A prefixable unit ID is absent from the unit registry.
A symbol identifier is not declared in the document namespace.
A unit ID or prefix is not present in the selected registry.
A symbol read has no visible successful assignment or binding.
A function is outside the closed v1 MathJSON allowlist.
An operator is outside the supported v1 expression grammar.
The unit kind is outside the supported v1 unit model.
A value is outside the scalar-only v1 value model.
A symbol binding is not referenced by the expression MathJSON.
